title: Zeus Juice Bar Liq Strawberry Burst Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Zeus Juice Bar Liq Strawberry Burst is a celebration of one of the most popular fruit flavours in vaping. This blend captures the essence of sweet, ripe Strawberry but amplifies it with a confectionery-inspired intensity. The result is a vibrant, sugary fruit profile that bursts with flavour on every inhale. The double-concentrated formula ensures that the strawberry notes are rich and impactful, avoiding any subtlety for a truly robust vape. Mixed to a 50VG/50PG ratio, this nicotine salt e-liquid is optimised for use with low-powered MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) hardware, such as pod vape kits and pen-style starter devices. The use of nicotine salts ensures a smooth throat hit and efficient nicotine satisfaction, even at higher strengths. For the best performance and flavour delivery, it is recommended to pair this e-liquid with coils or pods ranging between 0.6ohm and 1.2ohm. Bar Liq by the renowned UK manufacturer Zeus Juice is a collection of double-concentrated nicotine salts designed to deliver maximum flavour intensity. Known as "bar salts," these e-liquids are formulated with twice the flavour concentrate of standard blends, offering an intensely bold and vivid taste profile. Available in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths, Bar Liq provides a smooth and satisfying vape experience.
